answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 29246 Country: India Title: If we kiss our wife on cheeks and lips then it is compulsory to do ghusl please help on this matter Question: If we kiss our wife on cheeks and lips then it is compulsory to do ghusl please help on this matter Answer ID: 29246 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 168/168/M=1432) Ghusl shall be wajib if semen discharges because of the practice. And no ghusl shall be wajib if only madhi (pre-seminal fluid) discharges as it happens before foreplay etc. However, madhi breaks only wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
